articles.text: LÈBÙLǍNG: Nín hǎo a! Mǎi piàode chuāngkǒu hái méi kāi ne?
LEBLANC: Hello! The ticket window isn't open yet?
GŌNGRÉN: Méi na! Zài guò shífēn zhōng, jiǔdiǎn jiù kāi le. Nín cóng nǎr lái ya? Pǔtōnghuà shuōde zhème hǎo?
WORKER: Not yet. It'll open in another few minutes, at nine. Where are you from? You speak such good Chinese.
LÈBÙLǍNG: Wǒ shi Huáshèngdùn Yóubàode jìzhě, zài Běijīng yǐjing sānge yuè le.
LEBLANC: I'm a reporter from the Washington Post. I've been in Běijīng three months now.
GŌNGRÉN: Zài Běijīng chīde, zhùde dōu mǎnyì ma?
WORKER: Are you pleased with the food and living conditions here?
LÈBÙLǍNG: Chīde, zhùde dōu mǎnyì, wǒ tèbié xǐhuan Běijīngde xiǎochī.
LEBLANC: Yes. I especially like Běijīng's snacks.
GŌNGRÉN: Duì! Běijīngde xiǎochī shi yǒu míngde. Dōngdān yídàide xiǎochīdiàn nǐ dōu qùguo le ba?
WORKER: Right. Běijīng is famous for its snacks. I suppose you've been to all the little eateries in the Dōngdān area?
LÈBÙLǍNG: Dàbùfen dōu qùguo le. Zhēn bú cuò, qùle hái xiǎng qù.
LEBLANC: Most of them. They're great. You always want to go back.
GŌNGRÉN: Shì a, shì a! Nín jīntian xiǎng kàn shénme diànyǐngr a?
WORKER: Yes indeed. What movie do you want to see today?
LÈBÙLǍNG: Xiǎng kàn liǎngge xīnwénpiàn. Zhōngguóde xīnwénpiàn bú cuò.
LEBLANC: I want to see two newsreels. China has good newsreels.
GŌNGRÉN: Nín dōu kànguo shénme le?
WORKER: What ones have you seen?
LÈBÙLǍNG: Wǒ cháng kàn "Xīnwén Jiǎnbào," shàngcì kànle jièshào Huánán, Huáběide yícì xīnwénpiàn, bú cuò.
LEBLANC: I often see the "News Summaries." Last time I saw a newsreel presenting the north and south of China. It was pretty good.
GŌNGRÉN: Nín zuì xǐhuan nǎr a?
WORKER: What place did you like best?
LÈBÙLǍNG: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan Huángshān hé Guìlín.
LEBLANC: I liked Mt. Huáng and Guìlín best.
GŌNGRÉN: Ou! Nà shi hǎo dìfangr!
WORKER: Oh, those are nice places.
LÈBÙLǍNG: Wǒ hái kànguo yíbù jièshào shǎoshù mínzú shēnghuóde diànyǐng.
LEBLANC: I also saw a movie introducing the life of the minority nationalities.
GŌNGRÉN: Shi gùshipiānr a, háishi xīnwénpiānr a?
WORKER: Was it a feature film or a newsreel?
LÈBÙLǍNG: Xīnwénpiānr, shi guānyú Xīnjiāng, Nèiměng nèi yídàide.
LEBLANC: A newsreel. It was about the region of Xīnjiāng and Inner Mongolia.
GŌNGRÉN: Yǒu yíbù gùshipiānr jiào Wǔduǒ Jīnhuā, shi Dàlǐde shǎoshù mínzúde àiqíng gùshi, nǐ kànguo ma?
WORKER: There's a feature film called Five Golden Flowers, a love story about a national minority in Dàlǐ. Have you seen it?
LÈBÙLǍNG: Méi kànguo. Dàlǐ zài nǎr? Guìzhōu?
LEBLANC: No. Where's Dàlǐ? In Guìzhōu?
GŌNGRÉN: Bù, zài Yúnnán, nèi dìfangr kě hǎo kàn le.
WORKER: No, in Yúnnán. It's a gorgeous place.
LÈBÙLǍNG: Zhèige diànyǐng jīntian yǎn ma?
LEBLANC: Is that movie playing today?
GŌNGRÉN: Jīnr bù yǎn, xiàlǐbài yǎn, nín yào kàn, dǎ ge diànhuà gēn wǒmen diànyǐngyuàn liánxì yíxiàr, wǒmen kěyi gěi nín liú yìzhāng piào.
WORKER: Not today, but next week. If you want to see it, give us a call and get in touch, and we can save a ticket for you.
LÈBÙLǍNG: Zhēn xièxie nín. Āi, zhèige guǎnggào shi guānyú Dàqìngde ba?
LEBLANC: Thanks a lot. Say, is this ad about Dàqìng?
GŌNGRÉN: Shì, nà shi ge chū shíyóude dìfangr. Jīntiānde "Xīnwén Jiǎnbào"li jiù yǒu.
WORKER: Yes. They produce oil there. It's in today's "News Summary."
LÈBÙLǍNG: Ou, wǒ yào kàn zhèibù piānzi.
LEBLANC: Oh, I want to see that film.
GŌNGRÉN: Hǎo, mǎi piàode kāi ménr le. Nín kuài qù ba!
WORKER: Okay, the ticket office is open now. Go and buy your ticket.
LÈBÙLǍNG: Āi, xièxie nín. Zàijiàn!
LEBLANC: Right. Thank you. Good-bye!
GŌNGRÉN: Zàijiàn!
WORKER: Good-bye!
